author: Gmelin, 1789
summary: 농경지와 초지, 인가 주변에서 지내는 찌르레기로, 나무 위에서 열매나 곤충을 먹거나 초지와 농경지에서 곤충을 잡는다. 중국 남동부의 텃새이며 일부는 베트남 북부에서 겨울을 난다. 우리나라에서는 2000년 4월 강화도에서 수컷 한 마리가 처음 관찰된 뒤 제주도, 경기도 파주·의왕, 전라북도 군산 등지에서 서식과 번식이 확인되었다.

points.en: red bill with a black tip
white patch at the base of the primaries

sexes.male: 머리와 멱, 윗가슴은 엷은 황갈색이나 황백색으로 개체마다 다르고, 몸 윗면과 앞가슴, 가슴 옆은 청회색, 배는 탁한 흰색이다. 날개와 꼬리는 어두운 녹색 광택이 있는 검은색이다.
sexes.female: 전체가 갈색을 띠며 수컷과 달리 등이 갈색이다. 턱선은 흐릿한 갈색이고, 부리는 수컷보다 색이 엷다.

similar.how: 찌르레기는 머리가 검고 뺨이 희며 허리에 흰 띠가 있지만, 붉은부리찌르레기 수컷은 머리 전체가 희끄무레하고 허리에 흰 띠가 없으며 날 때 첫째날개깃 기부의 흰 무늬가 보인다.

art.subject: Red-billed Starling (Sturnus sericeus), adult male in spring: head, throat and upper breast silky whitish to pale buff, some birds tinged yellowish, the feathers fine and loose; mantle, back and scapulars soft blue-grey; wings glossy black with a dark green sheen and a neat white patch at the base of the primaries; rump pale grey; tail black glossed green; lower breast and breast sides blue-grey, belly dull white, undertail coverts grey; bill bright red with a black tip; dark brown iris; orange legs.
art.pose: walking in short grass, picking up insects
art.scene: Korean farmland and grassy field edge with scattered trees in spring; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched: silky pale buff-white head and throat, blue-grey back and breast, glossy black wings with a small white primary patch, grey undertail coverts, red bill with a black tip, orange legs
adult female, side view perched: duller grey-brown overall with a brownish back, head greyish-buff rather than white, same white primary patch, paler red bill with a dark tip, orange legs
adult male in flight, seen from above: black wings each with a white patch at the base of the primaries, blue-grey back, pale grey rump, black tail; head, body and tail in a straight line
art.build: Medium-sized, sleek starling, about as big as White-cheeked Starling (Spodiopsar cineraceus), clearly larger than a sparrow and much smaller than a pigeon. Rounded head without a crest; slim body, short square tail and pointed wings. Bill straight and pointed, a little shorter than the head. Legs medium length, orange. Walks briskly on the ground and perches upright in trees. At rest the white primary patch shows as a small white mark at the edge of the folded wing; in flight the white patch flashes at the base of the primaries and the pale grey rump contrasts with the black tail.
avoid: Do not paint a white rump or a black head with white cheeks — those are White-cheeked Starling (Spodiopsar cineraceus) traits.
Do not paint an all-red or yellow bill; the red bill has a distinct black tip.
Do not paint pink, yellow or dark legs; they are orange.
Do not add a crest; the head is rounded with loose, silky feathers.
